inference: The fixed physical-row batch admits too few eligible requests to fill its worker pool and waits before submitting the next batch. Many small durable files are placed on the HDD shared with exclusion. A bounded eligible-queue/NVMe comparison is warranted; no speedup factor or full-stock ETA is established.
measurement_scope: Non-atomic read-only census of retained attempt JSONs and C fetch-batch receipts while the worker was active. Counts from different points are not an atomic accounting ledger. Attempt elapsed includes HTTP, payload verification and persistence; it is not pure network latency or whole-worker cost. No controlled SSD/HDD speedup measured. Worker count and per-batch barriers verified in frozen implementation. Storage/free-space from lsblk/df.
